versions.changelog:
- Added license field (MIT) to metadata.
- Expanded the description for improved clarity and to mention usage with types and event handlers.
- Updated the Security & safety section formatting.
- Added a new "Finding endpoints and types" section with Go doc command examples and pkg.go.dev reference.
- Clarified REST and WebSocket usage instructions.
- Removed unused environment variable requirement from metadata.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

Initial release of Go integration for Solana Tracker Data API and Datastream.

- Provides typed Go clients for Solana Tracker REST and WebSocket APIs.
- Supports token prices, search, holders, trades, charts, wallet analytics, and real-time subscriptions.
- Reads API key from SOLANA_TRACKER_API_KEY and securely manages authentication.
- Includes safety notes on API key handling, rate limits, and processing external data.
- Guides integration setup, error handling, and offline testing.
- Intended for Go projects already importing github.com/psyb0t/go-solana-tracker.
